programme.sub-title: Fuerza de Ataque en el Golfo Pérsico

programme.title: Carriers at War LT
programme.desc: Observe cómo 4500 navegantes trabajan juntos para mantener al portaviones USS George H.W. Bush funcionando a máxima capacidad.

programme.title: Carriers at War LT
programme.desc: Desde el USS Langley a los aeropuertos flotantes de alta tecnología de hoy en día, sea testigo de la evolución de los portaviones y sus alas aéreas.

programme.title: Carriers at War LT
programme.desc: Sea testigo de cómo el USS Gerald R. Ford hizo frente a las críticas, superó sus dificultades técnicas y se convirtió en el buque de guerra del futuro.

programme.title: Carrier At War: The USS Enterprise
programme.desc: Suba a bordo del USS Enterprise para un excitante recorrido dentro de las vidas a bordo de un portaviones en tiempos de guerra.

programme.title: America's Greatest Monuments
programme.desc: ¿Qué tanto sabemos en realidad sobre los más grandes monumentos de los Estados Unidos? Inspirado en nuestros triunfos y tragedias, aprenda cómo estos icónicos lugares cuentan la historia americana.

programme.title: Civil War 360
programme.desc: Únase al actor Dennis Haysbert mientras analiza la lucha de aquellas víctimas de la esclavitud durante la Guerra Civil por medio de los objetos en la colección del Smithsoniano.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: La vecina de MacGyver, Kelly Dobbs, escucha un plan para asesinar al contador Victor Nesbitt. Victor es contador en una de las sociedades de cartera de Lyle Knox y planea exponer a la empresa.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver recoge al padre de su mejor amigo para llevarlo al bar mitzvá de su nieto y, sin darse cuenta, se ve involucrado en una misión del FBI y la CIA.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Después de que Prometheus, un pirómano enloquecido, es responsable de la muerte de su viejo amigo, MacGyver se propone resolver el misterio de este loco y capturarlo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver se enfrenta al extraño y aterrador mundo del vudú, mientras intenta salvar a su vecino políticamente activo de un escuadrón de la muerte trastornado y clandestino.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza lleva a MacGyver a la Inglaterra del siglo VII, donde busca sus raíces y rescata a una hermosa doncella de una reina malvada.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un golpe en la cabeza lleva a MacGyver a la Inglaterra del siglo VII, donde busca sus raíces y rescata a una hermosa doncella de una reina malvada.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Un comediante de cine mudo retirado, Pinky, dona sus películas a la Fundación Phoenix y juntos, él y MacGyver, se encuentran atrapados en una trampa mortal tejida por un maestro de efectos especiales llamado Neil que busca venganza.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver ayuda a su buen amigo Dent a entrenar para un combate de boxeo y descubre que debe rescatar a la hija de Dent de los jugadores que la han secuestrado.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Mientras trabaja en el Challenger Club,MacGyver descubre que debe salvar a los pandilleros locales de Minton, el proveedor local de armas que planea matar a todos los pandilleros y dejar que Jefferies cargue con la culpa de un asesinato que no cometió.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha para salvar un proyecto de vivienda después de que los propietarios corruptos hambrientos de dinero obligaron a los inquilinos a abandonar sus hogares.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver y su viejo amigo Jack Dalton descubren que los habitantes de un valle montañoso viven más de 150 años. Desafortunadamente, también descubren que es el sitio secreto de una planta de agua pesada utilizada para la tecnología de armas nucleares.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: Cuando MacGyver se involucra en un plan para detener el trabajo esclavo chino, descubre que tiene un hijo, Sam, que también está interesado en provocar la caída del hombre detrás de todo.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver es un héroe estadounidense moderno con la extraña habilidad de resolver una crisis en un tiempo extremadamente limitado, ya sea el audaz rescate de un arma secreta en la cima de una montaña o la salvación de científicos atrapados bajo tierra.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver escapa de un proyectil de bazuca cuidadosamente apuntado, se arrastra a través del lodo y crea el caos dentro de una fuerza militar corrupta para salvar a una hermosa reportera gráfica de un sindicato criminal mortal de América del Sur.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver, sin darse cuenta, invade un campamento en la jungla birmana y usa materiales primitivos para crear una serie de trampas para ayudar a los aldeanos que han sido víctimas de un ejército privado de mercenarios.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver huye de la policía de Budapest y la KGB mientras intenta liberar a una banda de carteristas gitanos encarcelados por robar un reloj que contiene información ultrasecreta.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: MacGyver lucha por su vida en una de sus aventuras más impresionantes mientras viaja a las junglas sofocantes de América del Sur, donde se encuentra con la terrible devastación causada por miles de millones de hormigas en el camino.

programme.title: MacGyver LT
programme.desc: El apuesto MacGyver es llevado al límite de sus innumerables trucos y métodos de escape únicos después de que unos ladrones despiadados incautan millones de dólares de un vehículo blindado y lo toman entre sus rehenes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera identidad de Mysterions es revelada. Mientras tanto, el Coon, despreciado por sus compañeros súper héroes, está en busca de venganza, y logra convencer a Cthulu para ser compañeros de equipo.

programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.desc: En el homenaje de South Park a la película "Heavy Metal", los chicos tratan de que Kenny se libre de la última locura por las drogas que ha capturado a la escuela.

programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan intenta borrar su cuenta de Facebook, pero acaba envuelto en el mundo virtual de la red social. Mientras, Kyle agrega a sus amistades a un niño nada popular y comienza a perder amigos.

programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan quiere aumentar la conciencia acerca del bullying y para eso hace un video de baile que se vuelve popular en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Butters es víctima del abuso de su cruel abuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan no puede parar de guardar cosas innecesarias en su armario y, al ser enviado con el Señor Mackey para tratar su problema, se da cuenta de que él consejero de la escuela tiene el mismo trastorno de acumulación compulsiva que él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan toca la marihuana que otros chicos mayores dejaron y, por la noche, llega un hombre que dice ser él mismo a los 32 años quién vuelve del futuro, perdido y drogado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman promueve el odio en la escuela hacia los niños con cabello rojo, pecas y piel pálida, diciendo que no tienen alma y no sobreviven al sol. Kyle, indignado, decide convertirlo en uno.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Damián, el hijo de Satanás, llega a South Park, él y su padre anuncian que la batalla final con Jesús se realizará en una lucha de boxeo que decidirá quién es el más fuerte.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison le explica a la clase la Teoría de la Evolución, aunque está totalmente en contra de esa postura. Mientras tanto, Cartman no puede esperar a que llegue el día del lanzamiento de una consola de videojuegos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Para vengarse de la profesora de arte, los chicos cubren su casa con papel higiénico. Cartman considera matar a Kyle para que él no los delate.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman no le queda otra que admitir que esta gordo, pero en lugar de hacer dieta para bajar de peso comienza a movilizarse en un scooter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toda su vida, el sueño de Cartman ha sido ser piloto de NASCAR y está dispuesto a hacer todo lo posible para que esto ocurra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños roban dientes a los niños menos afortunados y los venden al hada de los dientes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El restaurante favorito de Cartman ha cerrado y ha sido reemplazado por una tienda que vende marihuana medicinal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman siente curiosidad de saber quién es su padre, pero averiguarlo no es una tarea fácil debido a que su madre se acostó con muchos hombres.
programme.sub-title: La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando la mamá de Cartman se da cuenta que ya no puede controlarlo busca ayuda de un experto. César Millan, el "susurrador de perros", acepta el reto pero Cartman no cederá sin antes pelear.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que está muerto porque nadie responde a sus acciones. Se da cuenta que está atorado en la Tierra por sus fechorías, por lo que trata de hacer el bien dando regalos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se congela a sí mismo, despertando 500 años en el futuro cuando hay nutrias agresivas y lo peor de todo: ¡No hay Nintendo Wii! ¿Podrá Cartman escapar de ese crudo futuro?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Durante una recreación sobre la guerra civil americana, Cartman lidera al ejército de los confederados para atacar a los guerreros de la Unión al otro lado de América para poder ganar una apuesta a Kyle y Stan.
programme.sub-title: La insignia roja de la homosexualidad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Continuación de ''La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia'', en el que Cartman quiere averiguar quién es su padre. Con la ayuda de Chef, los chicos tienen que salvar al Doctor Mephesto luego de recibir un disparo.
programme.sub-title: La madre de Cartman es aún una sucia perra

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman sufre un fuerte golpe en la cabeza después de una caída casi fatal. La policía local asume que ahora Cartman tiene poderes psíquicos y lo contratan para resolver casos extraordinarios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras la señora Garrison está tratando de encontrar una forma de convertirse en el hombre que siempre intentó ser, Cartman es puesto a cargo del salón de clases.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.
programme.sub-title: El misterio del mojón en el urinal

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: Encuentros Extraterrestres: Los Grises

programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: Hopkinsville: Los Duendes Extraterrestres

programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres

programme.title: Archivos Gubernamentales de OVNIs Desclasificados

programme.desc: El equipo está tras la pista de un mutante pirómano que está causando el caos, mientras que Shalimar se ve obligada a dejar de lado su miedo al fuego para salvar a Emma.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El equipo ayuda a la tripulación de una estación de investigación oceánica amenazada por una criatura prehistórica que antes se creía extinta.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Shalimar accede a regañadientes a ponerse en contacto con su padre cuando el equipo se entera de que su empresa está involucrada en pruebas y manipulación genética.

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price, Doc Cheatham, J.C. Higginbotham & Elmer Crumbley
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent's orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith. Price was equally at home playing the blues in a trio, or leading a bigger band playing the jump-blues people loved to dance to. In this 1958 recording, Sammy plays the Comblain-La-Tour Jazz Festival with his band.

programme.title: Al McKay & Earth Wind & Fire Experience
programme.sub-title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Woody Herman, Paul Fontaine, Billy Hunt & Bill Chase
programme.sub-title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the "Swinging Herd," including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section. The band roars throughout the entire show which includes standards such as "Lonesome Old Town", "After You've Gone", and new originals including Charles Mingus's "Better Git It In Your Soul."

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. The symphony's finale movement is a chaconne, a variation form that reflects the composer's fascination with Baroque music. In this movement, Brahms borrowed an 8-measure theme from J. S. Bach's cantata ‘Nach dir, Herr, verlanget mich', BWV 150. The movement opens with the theme and then presents a set of variations all set over the same repeated theme in the bass. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.

programme.title: Big Mommas: Like Father, Like Son

programme.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
programme.desc: In this extraordinary true story of faith and survival, "On A Wing and A Prayer" follows passenger Doug White's (Dennis Quaid) harrowing journey to safely land a plane and save his entire family from insurmountable danger after their pilot dies unexpectedly mid-flight. Heather Graham also stars.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: The Great Ghost Rescue
programme.desc: Young Humphrey is a ghost with a big problem. He and his family, the Craggyfords, have been ousted from their home and left without a place to haunt. As they search for new haunting grounds they soon discover that they are not alone.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows. When Paul, who can't stand his sister's spoiled pet, abandons Marnie at a rural petrol station she comes across a loyal band of drifters who join forces to capture a notorious, local gang of petty thieves. A pur-fectly hilarious tail of friendship, secret-missions and side-splitting cat-itude! A.k.a. Marnie's World

programme.title: Pawparazzi
programme.desc: London Bridges, a fast rising Hollywood starlet, with her pampered pomeranian Latte in tow, arrives on location for "There Will Be Oil" and finds that she won't be receiving the star treatment that she is used to. AKA PupParazzi

programme.title: The Quest: The Longest Drive
programme.desc: To help out an old friend and save his ranch, the Beaudine brothers gather a bunch of oddballs to help drive a big herd to market. Dive into the exciting adventure with a stable worker, a retired gunslinger, a washed-up drunk, and two crafty rustlers as they take on the dusty trail.

programme.title: Mr Morgans Last Love
programme.desc: He's a widower in Paris who speaks no French. She's a dance instructor less than half his age. Can they become a family, or will his estranged adult children halt the friendship?

programme.title: Wildlife
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Joe is the only child of Jeanette and Jerry - a housewife and a golf pro - living a seemingly idyllic life in 1960s Montana. His family's carefully constructed façade is about to come crashing spectacularly down however, when Jerry loses his job - and his sense of purpose. In an attempt to restore his pride, Jerry takes off for the summer to help fight the wildfires raging near the Canadian border, a life-threatening job, for very little pay. An angry and bereft Jeanette must quickly learn to fend for herself, and does so with gusty, challenging cultural expectations and taking a quietly bewildered Joe along for the ride. An elegant adaption of the Richard Ford novel of the same name, Wildlife is an impressive directorial debut from Golden Globe nominee Paul Dano (There Will Be Blood, Love & Mercy), starring Carey Mulligan (Never Let Me Go, An Education, Shame, Suffragette), Jake Gyllenhaal (Nightcrawler, Brokeback Mountain, Donnie Darko), Ed Oxenbould (The Visit, Paper Planes) and Bill Camp (The Night Of, Loving, Midnight Special).

programme.title: Queen Of The Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attaché for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Gambler Jake Green enters into a game with potentially deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: A bedridden hospital patient captivates a girl with a tale of heroes, myths, and villains on a desert island.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A mortal teams with the god Horus in an alliance against Set, the god of darkness, who usurped Egypt's throne.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Alone. Afraid. Shut In. Get ready for an intense thrill ride of survival at any cost! A young mother finds herself barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex. With her kids on the other side of the door and the impending threat of violence, she must do whatever it takes to escape and get her kids out of the house.

programme.title: King Arthur: Excalibur Rising
programme.desc: The story of King Arth-yr Ddantgwyn comes to an end in the 520AD, in the battle of Camlann. In the heat of battle, Arth-yr, with the legendary Excalibur, lands a fatal blow to his son Mordred, before receiving a deadly wound himself. Before succumbing to his wounds, he tasks his loyal knight Sir Bedivere with returning Excalibur, the source of Arth-yr's powers, to the Lady in the Lake.

programme.title: The True Don Quixote
programme.desc: Down on his luck, Danny (Tim Blake Nelson – HBO's Watchmen) escapes the world by diving deep into the fantasy novels that bring him comfort. Diving a little too deep, he soon begins to believe that he himself is a great knight. Grabbing his cardboard armour, a sword and roping in his trusty squire Sancho (Jacob Batalon), they embark on an insane adventure, where great lessons are learned.

programme.title: Extra Time
programme.desc: Former football star Troy is coaxed into rescuing the local footy team who have been told they will have to merge with a rival club or fold. Troy takes the controversial decision to team up with a nearby refugee support centre and take the community on a journey of change. But for some, it proves challenging. A hilarious and heart-felt comedy described as The Full Monty for the football pitch.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: It is 1914. As the Great War looms, the mighty Ottoman Empire is crumbling. Constantinople, the once vibrant, multicultural capital on the shores of the Bosporus, is about to be consumed by chaos.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: Buddy Holly laid the foundations for a generation of popular music with his ground-breaking combination of country music and rhythm & blues.

programme.title: Warrior
programme.desc: The youngest son (Hardy) of an alcoholic former boxer (Nolte) returns home, where he's trained by his father for competition in a mixed martial arts tournament -- a path that puts the fighter on a collision corner with his older brother (Edgerton).

programme.title: Blue Moon Ball
programme.desc: (2022) Romance with Ashley Newbrough and Eric Lutz. While back in her hometown to finish her book, a novelist helps her ex save the town's historic ballroom - but can she write her own happy ending?

programme.title: My One and Only
programme.desc: (2019) Romance starring Pascale Hutton. A woman enters a TV reality show designed to help her find 'The One'. But when a love triangle forms on the set, how will she choose the right path for herself?

programme.title: When Love Came to Town
programme.desc: Abby is a famous author whose latest stop on her book tour takes her to the town of Bliss. But little does she know that the locals are keen to play matchmaker for her. Lauren Holly stars. (2014)

programme.title: Aloha Heart
programme.desc: (2023) Hawaii-set romance with Taylor Cole and Kanoa Goo. As they prep for her best friend's wedding, will conservationist Sara and hotel manager Manu realise their hearts are in the same place?

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: (2016) Romantic comedy starring Rachael Leigh Cook. A widowed mum enters the tech world, where love and coding crash into each other, creating the perfect romantic connection.

programme.title: Home Again
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon stars as Alice Kinney in HOME AGAIN a modern and heartwarming romantic comedy. Recently separated from her husband (Michael Sheen, Passengers), Alice decides to start over and move back to Los Angeles with her two young daughters as she struggles to get a new career off the ground.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: The perfect world of a beautiful Seattle television reporter is shattered by the prediction of her death in seven days.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly got married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot after having their annulment denied by a judge.

programme.title: 23 Walks
programme.desc: Dave and Fern, two older strangers, have been bruised by their individual circumstance. They meet walking their dogs in a North London park, and over the course of twenty-three walks together romance begins to blossom.

programme.title: Marilyn Hotchkiss Ballroom Dancing & Charm School
programme.desc: A widowed man's life turns upside down when he embarks on a journey to find a dying man's long lost love.

programme.title: A Rainy Day In New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen returns to the romantic fields of previous hits Vicky Cristina Barcelona and Midnight in Paris.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: Game Of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: After The Storm
programme.desc: Lauren wants to rebuild her community, including her family home, in the aftermath of a devastatingly disastrous storm.

programme.title: Love in Full Swing
programme.desc: Becks, a romance columnist decides to help her best friend Casey in search of his first love. On this journey, they both discover more about each other, and Becks faces a dilemma: help Casey or risk opening her heart.

programme.title: Seeking Persephone
programme.desc: To save her destitute family, Persephone Lancaster accepts a marriage proposal from Adam Boyce, the mysterious Duke of Kielder, the most feared man in the kingdom. Isolated in the duke's foreboding castle, Persephone searches for what happiness she can find. But Adam's determination to keep his new bride at a distance makes a future between them precarious.

programme.title: Love in Tahiti
programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.title: Follow Your Heart
programme.desc: When an eight year old girl loses her mother to cancer, her mother's last wish is for her to fall in love and find that special magical person. Twenty years later, she is alone, fired, and broke. When she and a friend decide to relocate to LA to start anew, she becomes attracted to their bus driver.

programme.title: Buried in Barstow
programme.desc: Angie Harmon plays Hazel King, a single mom concealing her past.

programme.title: Ten: Murder Island
programme.desc: Murder Island: Meg navigates past and future amidst frenemies and crushes.

programme.title: Lust, Lies, and Polygamy
programme.desc: Ellen begins to discover a web of lies that she must expose.

programme.title: Donna / Danelle / Robert and Ana
programme.desc: A convenience store worker plays dead to escape her abductor.

programme.title: Circle of Deception
programme.desc: New York Times bestseller by Ann Rule features Russel Douglas' murder mystery.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Alter
programme.desc: Alter, a psychological thriller about a man who is convinced that he's found his childhood abductor, and is determined to get him to confess by any means necessary.

programme.title: Love on the Vines
programme.desc: When Diana inherits half her uncle's vineyard, she is surprised to find a rule requiring her to work the land with new co-owner Seth or risk losing the land.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Events planner Kelly meets her match in web editor Joe when planning his niece's birthday party.

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Art historian Maddie searches for the "Lovers Stone" in the Caribbean with the help of a charming hotelier.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Are We There Yet? (2005)
programme.desc: Ice Cube plays Nick, a playboy bachelor and sports memorabilia collector who dates a divorced mother of two young kids who never like the men their mom dates. Things go awry when Nick offers to drive the kids from Portland to Vancouver where their mother is stuck for work.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year's Eve after a bout of fateful events.

programme.title: Golden Years
programme.desc: When Arthur and Martha find that their pension pot is virtually worthless they decide to take drastic action by robbing a bank! After their first robbery is successful they start to like the criminal lifestyle, but as the robberies get riskier will they be able to outwit the police as they close in?

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: India Sweets and Spices
programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: Arizona Colt Returns
programme.desc: Famed gunman Arizona Colt is sent by Moreno to rescue his daughter from the grips of Arizona's old enemy, Keane. But certain complications make the mission far more dangerous than expected.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a simple farmhand must get help from a group of wild misfits and find treasure before the outlaw he's been impersonating finds him.

programme.title: Hellgate
programme.desc: Accused of spying for the Confederacy, a man is sent to the brutal Hellgate Prison. After a failed escape lands him in solitary confinement, his path to redemption begins. When a deadly plague strikes the prison, he faces the ultimate test of character, transforming his dire circumstances into a chance for renewal.

programme.title: Singing Guns
programme.desc: Notorious stagecoach robber Rhiannon is unintentionally appointed as deputy when he saves the sheriff's life and must wear two hats between his new job that he enjoys and his old occupation that he misses.

programme.title: Father's Doing Fine
programme.desc: The adventures of an impoverished upper-class family consisting of a widowed mother and her four daughters.

programme.title: Baby and the Battleship
programme.desc: Two sailors go ashore when HMS Gillingham puts into Naples.

programme.title: His Excellency
programme.desc: George's arrival in Arista as His Excellency represents a break in the long line of wealthy, titled Governors

programme.title: The Secret Place
programme.desc: For Molly, life in London's East End is colourless. The same is true for Freddie, her best friend who idolises her. But she is in love with the local crook, Gerry.

programme.title: Hamlet

programme.title: Last of the Mochicas

programme.title: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney reunites with her high school sweetheart to track down a Hawaiian fertility idol in Madagascar.

programme.title: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney receives a deck of rare Tarot cards from her recently deceased friend. The infamous, previously unmentioned Vulture was after him. Sydney enlists Claudia to help.

programme.title: Three Rivers to Cross

programme.title: Lost Contact

programme.title: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: When two graduate students on the trail of the Haitian Cross of Utu disappear in New Orleans, Sydney and Nigel go down on the bayou to find them.

programme.title: Roman Holiday

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: When objects start to go missing from her home, Sophie Hartley (Susan Sarandon) suspects that a stalker is responsible. Then she meets Mara (Emily Blunt), the new co-worker of her husband, Craig (Sam Neill), and after seeing her in a dress that was among the vanished items, Sophie believes that Mara is obsessed with her. Unfortunately, she takes her suspicions too far, which leads to legal ramifications and her husband becoming concerned for her well-being -- but also to a startling discovery.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: I Smile Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Addicted to drugs and alcohol, a housewife's self-destructive behavior starts to take its toll on her husband and two young children.

programme.title: A Little Trip to Heaven
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Abraham Holt travels to a tiny town in rural Minnesota to look into a particularly unusual insurance claim stemming from a horrific car accident. As Holt examines the scene of the wreck, it all seems a bit too perfect. And when he interviews Isold McBride and her shifty husband, Fred -- the impoverished beneficiaries of the massive, recently initiated life-insurance policy -- he begins to suspect that something is amiss.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Freeway [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crazed driver with a deeply troubled past goes on a nightly shooting spree across the highways of America.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Coeur volé
programme.desc: Melissa est enrôlée par le PDG de la plus grande compagnie de bijoux de Miami pour l'aider à créer une ligne pour les mariées.

programme.title: De la rumeur au scandale
programme.desc: Deux adolescentes entreprennent de démasquer une personne qui dévoile anonymement des scandales de leur école sur Internet.

programme.title: Fatale infidélité
programme.desc: Une enquêteuse privée croit qu'elle a rencontré l'amour de sa vie, mais est-ce un véritable amour, ou sera-t-il son pire cauchemar?

programme.title: Grace et Isla : la mort pour un garçon
programme.desc: Lorsque Grace et Isla découvrent qu'elles sortent avec le même garçon, elles utilisent les réseaux sociaux pour s'attaquer mutuellement.

programme.title: Laurent de Wilde
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne. Alongside bassist Jérôme Regard and drummer Donald Kontomanou, De Wilde gives a respectful and engaging homage built upon 20 years of study.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price, Doc Cheatham, J.C. Higginbotham & Elmer Crumbley
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent's orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith. Price was equally at home playing the blues in a trio, or leading a bigger band playing the jump-blues people loved to dance to. In this 1958 recording, Sammy plays the Comblain-La-Tour Jazz Festival with his band.

programme.title: Al McKay & Earth Wind & Fire Experience
programme.sub-title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind & Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. One of the bands performing here in 2019 is The Earth, Wind & Fire Experience. In this concert, original Earth, Wind & Fire guitarist, writer and musical director Al McKay performs the band's timeless disco and soul. Together with seven of the thirteen original Earth, Wind & Fire members, he keep hits such as Boogie Wonderland and September alive, touring all over the world.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Tony Coe, Derek Humble & Billy Mitchell
programme.desc: American jazz trumpeter, composer, and bandleader Dizzy Gillespie (1917-1993) was one of the seminal figures of the bebop movement. He fuses all musical forms rooted in African culture, such as music from Cuba, Latin America and the Caribbean, into his music. On November 4, 1970 he played a concert in Denmark with the Kenny Clarke/Francy Boland Big Band, performing Con Alma, Brother K, Now Hear My Meanin', Manteca, Let Me Outta Here, and Things Are Here.

programme.title: Charles Bradley, William Aukstik, Frederick Deboe & Michael Deller
programme.sub-title: Charles Bradley: The Screaming Eagle Of Soul
programme.desc: This concert of soul singer Charles Bradley (1948-2017) was recorded in an intimate setting in Paris in September 2014. Before considering a career in music, Bradley had long tried to make ends meet with a series of small jobs. It was only in 1996 that he finally followed in the footsteps of his idol and soul icon James Brown, with whom he shared an exceptional ability to bring audiences to ecstasy. Bradley has developed a unique sound that combines funk, soul, and R&B, but still tinged with Brown influences.

programme.title: Red Norvo, Dave Brubeck Quartet, The Gary Burton Quartet & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, jazz's greatest artists appeared at the third Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam. This broadcast features the bands of pianist Dave Brubeck, vibraphonists Gary Burton and Red Norvo, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie.

programme.title: Woody Herman, Paul Fontaine, Billy Hunt & Bill Chase
programme.sub-title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the "Swinging Herd," including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section. The band roars throughout the entire show which includes standards such as "Lonesome Old Town", "After You've Gone", and new originals including Charles Mingus's "Better Git It In Your Soul."

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: Martha Argerich
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. The symphony's finale movement is a chaconne, a variation form that reflects the composer's fascination with Baroque music. In this movement, Brahms borrowed an 8-measure theme from J. S. Bach's cantata ‘Nach dir, Herr, verlanget mich', BWV 150. The movement opens with the theme and then presents a set of variations all set over the same repeated theme in the bass. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Marta Gardolińska, Gareth Davies & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie & Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger's D'un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie's Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky's semi-autobiographical symphony. LSO principal flute Gareth Davies brings out all the dazzle and daring of Dalbavie's 21st-century classic. The program closes with Prayer for Ukraine by composer Valentin Silvestrov. This concert was recorded at LSO St Luke's in London, UK, on May 18, 2022.

programme.title: Orquesta Filamonica de Buenos Aires, Carlos Gari, Daniel Barenboim & Mora Godoy
programme.sub-title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor & soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year's Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics. The old master of tango, José Carli, created enchanting new arrangements of works by Argentinean artists Astor Piazzolla, Carlos Gardel, Julio de Caro, Alberto Ginastera and Horacio Salgán. Performances by leading tango dancers Mora Godoy and Junior Cervilla from Buenos Aires add atmosphere and round off the night.

programme.title: Def Leppard
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let's Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: John Legend
programme.desc: An artist with intellectual skills is John Legend, who studied English with a major in African American literature at the University of Pennsylvania. In college, he participated in a jazz group called Counterparts and at the time was introduced to singer Lauryn Hill, playing piano on the track 'Everything Is Everything' from the singer's first solo album. He finished college in 1999 and began composing his own songs Recorded two independent albums that were sold in their performances: 'John Stephens' (2000) and 'Live at Jimmy Uptown' (2001). He has performed on albums of singers like Alicia Key, Jay-Z and also made the album Wake Up! (2010) along with the American rap group, The Roots. His official discography includes Get Lifted (2004), Once Again (2006), Evolver (2008) and Love in the Future (2013). This presentation in London, 2014, at the Itunes Festival, manages to clean the career of this singer who besides being multitalented can be a human rights activist.
